protocol: Abstract-only machine extraction; every quote is a verbatim substring; verified=false.

evidence.summary: 实验结果表明，基于SDAE的CADx算法在性能上显著优于传统方法，表明深度学习技术可以改变CADx系统的设计范式，无需显式设计和选择面向问题的特征。
evidence.quote: The experimental results show the significant performance boost by the SDAE-based CADx algorithm over the two conventional methods, suggesting that deep learning techniques can potentially change the design paradigm of the CADx systems without the need of explicit design and selection of problem-oriented features.
evidence.sample: breast ultrasound lesions and lung CT nodules

evidence.summary: 模型在区分肝癌和胆管癌的准确率与医生共识诊断水平相当
evidence.quote: comparable with the diagnostic level of doctors' consensus (70.8%)

evidence.summary: ResNet50模型在手动选择组中对活体VRF牙齿的诊断效率高于VGG19、DensenNet169和有2年经验的放射科医生。
evidence.quote: In manual selection group, ResNet50 presented higher diagnostic efficiency in diagnosis of in vivo VRF teeth than VGG19, DensenNet169 and radiologist with 2 years of experience.
evidence.method: 使用ResNet50、VGG19和DenseNet169三种深度学习网络进行诊断，与放射科医生的诊断结果进行比较。
evidence.sample: 276颗牙齿（138颗VRF牙齿和138颗非VRF牙齿）的CBCT图像。

evidence.summary: 深度学习模型辅助放射科医生在检测急性缺血性卒中病变方面表现更好，支持深度学习在影像诊断任务上接近专科医生水平的主张。
evidence.quote: With the assistance of our proposed DL model, radiologists got better performance in the detection of AIS lesions on NCCT.
evidence.method: 多中心研究，使用深度学习模型辅助放射科医生进行诊断，并评估其性能。
evidence.sample: 1391名患者用于模型开发，85名患者用于外部验证。

evidence.summary: 该模型在皮肤癌分类任务中表现优异，可作为皮肤科医生早期检测黑色素瘤的辅助工具，表明其性能接近专科医生水平。
evidence.quote: the proposed approach would be able to serve as a valuable tool for assisting dermatologists in the early detection of melanoma
evidence.method: hybrid deep learning approach based on U-Net, Inception-ResNet-v2, and Vision Transformer model
evidence.sample: dermoscopic images from ISIC2020 dataset and HAM10000 dataset

evidence.summary: 深度学习重建的ULD-DLR图像在肾结石检测率上达到95.4%，接近专科医生水平。
evidence.quote: Stone detection rates of ULD-HIR and ULD-DLR images were 93.1% (121/130) and 95.4% (124/130).

evidence.summary: 该模型在诊断甲状腺癌颈部淋巴结转移时表现优于放射科医生。
evidence.quote: It outperformed radiologists with an area under the curve of 0.894.
evidence.method: 使用改进的基于区域的检测网络和具有注意力模块的残差网络进行分类。
evidence.sample: 676个淋巴结（103个良性，573个恶性）来自196名接受CT检查进行手术计划的患者。

evidence.summary: 深度学习模型在PET/CT影像中能有效检测、分割和分类高代谢肺病变，并识别可疑相邻病变，表明其性能接近专科医生水平。
evidence.quote: Deep learning models based on PET/CT imaging can effectively detect, segment, and classify hypermetabolic lung lesions, and identify suspicious adjacent lesions.
evidence.method: 使用PET/CT影像开发深度学习模型进行检测和分类，与放射组学方法进行比较。
evidence.sample: 647例病例，包括内部数据集（426例）和两个外部测试集（151例和70例）

evidence.summary: 该模型在测试中表现出高准确率、高灵敏度和较高的特异性，表明其性能接近或达到专科医生水平。
evidence.quote: The experimental results in this paper showed that in the last round of testing, the accuracy of ResNet model including deconvolution structure reached 95.2%. The area under curve (AUC) value of the working characteristics of the subject is 0.987. The sensitivity was 99.66%, and the specificity was 88.61%.
evidence.sample: 未明确说明样本数量和来源

evidence.summary: AI在肿瘤影像学中的临床转化仍受到严格验证、可操作的可解释性、标准化、治理和工作流程整合方面的限制。
evidence.quote: Question AI translation in oncologic imaging remains constrained by limitations in rigorous validation, actionable interpretability, standardization, governance, and workflow integration.

evidence.summary: 发现81名中国专家就30条临床实用的陈述达成共识，涵盖从早期检测到部署的AI应用。
evidence.quote: Findings Eighty-one Chinese experts reached consensus on 30 clinically practical statements covering AI applications from early detection to deployment.

evidence.summary: LiLNet在良性与恶性肿瘤的诊断中达到94.7%的准确率和97.2%的AUC值，表明其性能接近或达到专科医生水平。
evidence.quote: LiLNet achieves an accuracy (ACC) of 94.7% and an area under the curve (AUC) of 97.2% for benign and malignant tumors.

evidence.summary: 深度学习模型在诊断急性胆囊炎和预测化脓性胆囊炎方面表现优于放射组学模型和放射科医生评估
evidence.quote: Deep learning significantly surpassed radiomics models and radiologist assessments
evidence.method: 比较深度学习模型与放射组学模型和放射科医生评估
evidence.sample: 641名来自三个医疗中心的患者

evidence.summary: 大多数AI医疗器械通过510(k)途径获得批准，说明其临床有效性证据可能不足。
evidence.quote: The majority (85.9%) was approved by the FDA with a 510(k) clearance, while 8 (12.5%) received de novo pathway clearance and one (1.6%) premarket approval (PMA) clearance.

evidence.summary: 深度学习模型在多种医学影像模态中能够以高精度预测种族，表明其性能接近或达到专业水平。
evidence.quote: standard AI deep learning models can be trained to predict race from medical images with high performance across multiple imaging modalities
evidence.method: 使用私有和公共数据集评估深度学习模型在检测种族方面的性能，包括模型在外部环境和多种影像模态中的泛化能力。
evidence.sample: Emory CXR, Emory Chest CT, Emory Cervical Spine, Emory Mammogram, MIMIC-CXR, CheXpert, National Lung Cancer Screening Trial, RSNA Pulmonary Embolism CT, Digital Hand Atlas

evidence.summary: AI模型检测种族的能力并非源于与种族相关的替代变量，说明其泛化能力可能被低估。
evidence.quote: this detection is not due to proxies or imaging-related surrogate covariates for race (eg, performance of possible confounders: body-mass index [AUC 0·55], disease distribution [0·61], and breast density [0·61])
evidence.method: 通过回归模型评估解剖和表型人口特征对种族检测的可能混淆作用，并在分层数据集上重新评估深度学习模型。
evidence.sample: body-mass index, disease distribution, breast density

evidence.summary: 研究评估了深度学习模型在医学影像中检测种族的能力，包括其在外部环境和多种影像模态中的泛化能力，表明外部验证和公平性证据不足。
evidence.quote: we evaluated, first, performance quantification of deep learning models in detecting race from medical images, including the ability of these models to generalise to external environments and across multiple imaging modalities
evidence.method: 使用私有和公共数据集评估深度学习模型在检测种族方面的性能，包括模型在外部环境和多种影像模态中的泛化能力。
evidence.sample: Emory CXR, Emory Chest CT, Emory Cervical Spine, Emory Mammogram, MIMIC-CXR, CheXpert, National Lung Cancer Screening Trial, RSNA Pulmonary Embolism CT, Digital Hand Atlas
